verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Meta publishes a model card for every released weight family [llama-supp-model-cards] and ships benchmark results with releases [llama-comm-10]. It also offers a CLI to show each model's prompt format [llama-gh-4]. Nothing documents eval names, settings, harness or eval prompts, and Meta's own materials say the LMArena Maverick entry was a separate 'experimental chat version', which undermines comparability [llama-comm-17]. Missing for 10: documented eval suite names and shot/sampling settings, a published eval harness or eval prompts, consistency between benchmarked and released checkpoints, and independent reproduction of the claims.
